scope: Per-prompt comparison of P150, P150x2, and P150x4 vLLM outputs against the retained same-suite HF plus standalone-TT control

prompt_format.serving_method: OpenAI /v1/chat/completions; vLLM applies the checkpoint chat template

comparison_method: The greedy serving result is the direct same-prompt and same-template comparison; the sampled result is checked for the same requested task, language, and structure. Lexical identity is not required for free-running generation. All retained completions were read through their requested cap.

machine_learning_haiku.comparison: The HF/standalone-TT control and every serving profile produce a coherent three-line English haiku about data, patterns, and learning; no repetition or task drift appears.

supervised_unsupervised.comparison: The control and every serving profile use the same simple teacher-and-fruit framing, correctly distinguish labels from discovery, and remain coherent through the serving-length continuation.

inventor_story.comparison: The control and every serving profile continue the faraway-kingdom inventor premise as coherent English fantasy prose; ordinary creative divergence introduces no collapse, echo, or cross-request leakage.

thermodynamics_laws.comparison: The control and every serving profile correctly organize the first, second, and third laws while noting the zeroth law; all continuations stay factual and on topic.

french_translation.comparison: The control and every serving profile give correct formal and informal French translations with English framing; no wrong-language drift occurs.

fibonacci_function.comparison: The control and every serving profile provide valid iterative Python Fibonacci logic and structured explanation; longer responses truncate only at the explicit 256-token limit.
